reviews.quote: Cayla stood by us for over a year, drove hundreds of miles to look at countless houses for us while we lived in California.  We had a house go under contract in June of 2020, flew out to take a closer look and after a thorough inspection, the house needed too much work to justify the cost.  Cayla supported us through the process and didn’t hesitate to continue the search for us.  We moved to Nashville the next month and decided to land in a rental while we got more familiar with the new city.  She still would check in and see if we needed anything, even though the house search was on pause.  When we started our search again at the beginning of 2021 Cayla did what she does best, put her all into finding us the best house for our family.  She didn’t want to sell us the most expensive house, but make sure we found a location, house, and neighborhood that would be best for our family of 5.  After six offers, our seventh offer was finally accepted and we had requested a 40 day escrow to prepare us for a construction loan (FHA 203k).  There were so many different issues we ran into (all of which were out of control) but Cayla was consistent, calm and negotiated 3 extensions with the listing agent.  I’m positive there were many conversations and negotiations she had that we didn’t know about that helped us successfully close on the house 60 days later.  If you are looking for an agent, look no further.  Cayla will make sure you are taken care of and that you truly get the house you deserve.  THANK YOU Cayla for all your help in getting our family into our first home!

reviews.quote: Cayla was an excellent agent when it came to selling our Green Hills townhome. From the moment we decided to sell, she was honest about staging for showings, helping us present the unit in its best light to attract the most buyers. She also kept us informed of the recommended listing price and adjusted this until the moment it was listed based on the surrounding area and market demand, making sure we were not over- or under-priced. There were additional units that had recently sold in our complex, and she reached out to buyers who "missed out" on those and informed them about our upcoming listing. She also held an open house and promoted the unit numerous times across her social media pages -- all of these action items got our unit under contract within a week of listing. She kept us well informed during the inspection period, and when issues with our unit arose, she had her service professionals out to resolve the problems that week. She answered every question we had and made sure we were comfortable and informed throughout the entire process. We are so grateful that we found Cayla in this Nashville market, and we would highly recommend her to anyone looking to buy or sell their property in the future.

reviews.quote: We used Cayla to buy our first home, but that statement barely scratches the surface of what all she did for us. She asked us in-depth questions to determine what was the most important to us in our home buying journey, and her thoroughness found us our dream home. She reached out to other realtors on our behalf, constantly seeking the type of home we wanted, advocating for us every step of the way. Surely, she found our dream home in our dream neighborhood and we secured it the day it hit the market. Once we were under contract, she connected us to every single professional we needed during the inspection period, enabling us to make the most informed decisions about our negotiation process. Once we closed on the property, she continued to check in and support us by connecting us with vendors to make this house OUR home. Her communication was consistent and professional -- something that is incredibly hard to find these days. I am more than happy to share my experiences with anyone else who is curious about what it is like to work with Cayla Cook -- we will not use anyone else (although, let's be honest, we plan to be in our dream home for a LONG time). We could not have done any of this without her insight, expertise, and experience in this market.
